mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, message_type, status, sort_order, created_time, updated_time FROM ai_conversation_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation_message ( id, conversation_id, role, content, message_type, status, sort_order, created_time, updated_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{messageType}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content = VALUES(content), message_type = VALUES(message_type), status = VALUES(status), sort_order = VALUES(sort_order), updated_time = NOW()
